source: https://www.kuntiqi.com/surfboard-models/ (WooCommerce surfboard model pages only — excludes SUPs, custom deposits, and eco-project one-offs)

brands.name: Kun_tiqi
brands.short_description: Hollow fibreglass-free paulownia wooden surfboards handcrafted in Loredo, Cantabria, with a named standup range and official dedicated model pages.

models.name: 60s SINGLEFIN
models.description: Swooping arcs. Smooth turns. Beautiful lines. The 60s single fin allows you to surf with a sense of effortless retro cool.

models.name: RETRO QUAD
models.description: Fast, stable and manoeuvrable, the Retro Quad is a real wave catcher that's perfectly designed for fun, high-speed surfing.

models.name: BEAN
models.description: For a fresh and funky surfing experience, you can't go past our super manoeuvrable Mini Simmons-style Bean wooden surfboard.

models.name: PHENI
models.description: Shortboard performance meets the speed and rideability of a fish. The Pheni is an excellent travel board and daily driver.

models.name: 70s SINGLEFIN
models.description: Want to unlock your inner soul surfer? Our 70s single fin is cruisy yet able to perform when the conditions demand it.

models.name: RETRO TWIN FISH
models.description: Fast and skatey with plenty of drive, the Retro Twin Fish is a tried and tested small wave board for surfers of all skill levels.

models.name: MALIBU
models.description: Simple, stylish and easy to both paddle and catch waves on, the Malibu is a highly popular board amongst longboard lovers. The squash tail adds looseness and manoeuvrability for quick directional changes while still trimming and noseriding.

models.name: ORCA
models.description: A small wave weapon that generates plenty of speed in average waves, the Orca is a fun and forgiving travel board.

models.name: EGG
models.description: The Egg is an all-in-one-board that'll never let you down. It's got glide, it's easy to paddle and it catches all the waves.

models.name: FEGG
models.description: With lots of volume, a flat rocker plus amazing stability, the Fegg is fast on fat waves yet able to turn on a dime.

models.name: PERFORMER LONGBOARD
models.description: The Performer Longboard is our ultimate surprise package. It loves going fast and surfing in the pocket on bigger and faster waves.

models.name: Noserider – Henrietta
models.description: Fast and comfortable underfoot, the Classic Noserider is the cultivated cross-stepper's dream longboard surfboard.

models.name: NOSERIDER
models.description: The Noserider is a classic longboard with a beautiful outline that allows you to hang 10 across mellow waves all day long.
